headline: Sensex and Nifty Rally for Second Day Driven by Foreign Inflows and Oil Prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows (FII inflows) fueled the November market surge
Moderate crude oil prices helped sustain positive investor sentiment
Banking stocks rallied, lifting the Nifty Bank index to a record high
Markets opened higher despite weak cues and sell-offs in global markets
whatHappening: Sensex ended 427 points higher while Nifty settled above the 25,350 mark
Sensex zoomed up to 800 points intraday with Nifty touching 25,500 levels
FIH Mauritius is set to sell a 13% stake in IIFL Finance through a Rs 3,454-crore clean-out trade
UBS warned that Indian stock market valuation premiums face tests from tight interest rates and slower growth
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extended their rally for a second straight session, propelled by strong foreign capital inflows and moderate oil prices. Banking stocks outperformed, pushing Nifty Bank to fresh record highs. Separately, IIFL Finance was in focus following reports of a major Rs 3,454-crore block deal.
